title: Contour Field Background
tagline: Animated topographic contour lines on Canvas, with zero dependencies.
description:
Contour Field draws a slowly drifting topographic map behind your content. Contours are traced with marching squares over 3D simplex noise, and every fifth line can be highlighted in an accent colour.

It is built for real pages: frame rate is capped, the animation pauses when the canvas is off screen or the tab is hidden, high-DPI screens stay sharp without overdrawing, and visitors who prefer reduced motion get a single still frame.

The download includes the module, a demo page with live density, speed, zoom and theme controls, a preview server and documentation with a React example.
requirements: Optional: Node.js 18+ for the bundled preview server
technologyNotes: One ES module (src/contour-field.js) exporting createContourField(). No dependencies.
